messages:
meera: Heads-up — onboarding reranker-v4 with mixed PTQ (weights int4, acts fp16). Overall NDCG stable but MRR splits: short queries (<=6 tokens) MRR down ~4-6%, long queries (>=150 tokens) sometimes up. Any ideas?

tom: short-query MRR drops typically mean activation clipping or feature direction loss during per-layer scales. share slice + quant config?

meera: slice=onboard_mix_v1, n=12k (shorts n=2.3k, longs n=3.1k), candidates=100. quant: per-channel int4 weights, fp16 acts, per-layer activation-scaling derived from uniform calib (2k samples), clip=3.2. seed=11.

nina: tokenizer parity ok? Also check candidate normalization and dedupe pre-score — short queries can flip rank if near ties.

meera: token parity yes, dedupe/order unchanged. I pulled a failing example:
```
query: "pip cache"
correct: "pip cache purge"
alt: "pip install --upgrade pip"
float_logits: [correct: 2.9, alt: 1.1]
int4_logits:  [correct: 0.8, alt: 0.9]
```

meera: correct candidate logit drops a lot; others roughly same. eval-bot: run 3187654330 finished. full MRR@10 float=0.412 int4=0.391 (-0.021). short bin MRR delta -0.046. long bin delta +0.012.

tom: hypothesis A: calibration sample underrepresents short-query activations (embedding/attention patterns). Hypothesis B: per-channel weight rounding shifts few neurons important for short prompts.

nina: ablation plan: (1) calibrate with short-heavy sample (50% shorts), (2) increase clip to 6.0, (3) try per-layer bias correction, (4) loss-aware PTQ optimizing for short-query logit preservation. Include seed parity (use seed=2026).

meera: queued 4 ablations. will post compact numbers when ready. If (1) or (4) fixes, add "short-query golden set" to onboarding checklist.

ops-bot: note: keep canary concurrency fixed to 1 to avoid batching nondeterminism during runs.

meera: thanks — will follow up with numbers only. PR for checklist if confirmed.
